name: Do-Fluoride New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Do-Fluoride New Materials Co., Ltd., previously named Do-Fluoride Chemicals Co., Ltd., is an enterprise primarily focused on the research, development, manufacturing, and international sale of inorganic fluorides, electronic chemicals, and both components and complete systems for lithium-ion batteries. Their extensive product line includes various smelting-grade fluorides such as anhydrous aluminum fluoride, hydrogen fluoride, synthetic cryolite, and granulated synthetic cryolite. They also supply sodium fluoride, fluosilicate, potassium fluoaluminate, potassium borofluoride, and anhydrous calcium chloride. For the electronics sector, the company provides high-purity chemicals like lithium hexafluorophosphate and hydrofluoric acid, along with standard samples of cryolite and aluminum fluoride. Additionally, Do-Fluoride ventures into the electric vehicle market and provides financial loan services. The company was founded in 1999 and operates from its headquarters in Jiaozuo, located in the People's Republic of China.
